---
title: regularizeNd

This page is the home for a full tutorial series on regularizeNd, a set of foundation pages on the mathematics behind it, and one deep-dive technical article.

##  Software and Repo

- [Download regularizeNd from FileExchange](https://www.mathworks.com/matlabcentral/fileexchange/61436-regularizend)
- [regularizeNd GitHub Repo](https://github.com/jasonnicholson/regularizeNd/)
- [regularizeNd Documentation](https://jasonhnicholson.com/regularizeNd/). The documentation is available with the GitHub repo via GitHub Pages or in the FileExchange download. Note, the examples overlap the tutorial series but are not identical. You don't need to look at both.

## Choose your path

- **Use regularizeNd.** Work through the tutorial series below. No foundations are required. The tutorials explain the public options and how to tune them.
- **Understand the internals.** Read the foundation pages first, then the deep-dive article, and then Parts 6 to 8 where they apply. The foundations are prerequisites for the deep dive, but they are optional for ordinary use of the function.

## Understand the Internals: Foundations

These three pages rebuild the method from its equations. They are written for this site and do not depend on the external articles. Read them in order.

1. [Foundations: Regularizing Data with One Input](foundations-2d-data.qmd). Fidelity rows, second-difference smoothness, stacked least squares, residuals, and grid-resolution normalization.
2. [Foundations: From Equations to an Efficient Solve](foundations-regularizedata2d-spreadsheet.qmd). Sparse assembly, the normal equations, and why a solver should not form explicit inverses.
3. [Foundations: Regularizing 3D Data (2D Input)](foundations-3d-data.qmd). Bilinear weights on a grid, directional smoothness, and unwrapping a surface into `ndgrid` order.

## Deep-Dive Scientific Article

- [Deep-Dive: regularizeNd Design](deep-dive-regularizeNd-design.qmd). Complete the foundations first if you want the derivations behind the design choices.
